title: A Blue Hour for the Glasshouse
author: Mara Almeida
blurb: Silas Eastwick, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
